notes.title: Second Demo Available Now!
notes.content:
Hi architects! Demo
We have just released the second demo version of the game. 

You can play it now! 

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3563960/Astro_Architect_Demo/"][/dynamiclink]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45528773/127da4c13b15e39b16f6390b688741f95bb73c09.png"]
Feedback 
All your feedback will be appreciated and will have impact on how the final game looks and plays. There's a special section in Steam Community Hub for telling us what you think, but feel free to create your own threads there. 

There's also dedicated in game function to leave us feedback or report any bugs. 





Your Frost Crown Studio

notes.title: Work status and Discord
notes.content:
Hi architects!

Work status
We haven't written in a while, but that doesn't mean we're not working on the game. 

We have just finished all the core mechanics and are starting to work on content for the third and fourth tiers of employees.



Here you have all tiers quarters. Worker -> Technician -> Engineers -> Scientist (WIP name)

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45528773/e7d2773a8c1fb4581bb42053a637d7e62990c83d.png"]


Discord Server
In addition, we finally created a discord where we are going to share the progress of the work asking for your feedback. If you want to be part of the development, please join our Discord server

notes.title: Hotfix Patch 0.0.12
notes.content:
Hi architects!

We fixed a bug which blocked playing the game after opening the Expedition Map. Sorry for that :c

Your Frost Crown Studio

notes.title: Demo Available Now!
notes.content:
Hi architects!

As we previously announced, we are pleased to announce that demo version of Astro Architect is available to be played right now!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3563960/Astro_Architect_Demo/

While the game downloads, check out the first trailer.

[previewyoutube=EKr0zu9Zf4Y;full][/previewyoutube]

Feedback
All your feedback will be appreciated and will have impact on how the final game looks and plays.

There's a special section in Steam Community Hub for telling us what you think, but feel free to create your own threads there.

There's also dedicated in game function to leave us feedback or report any bugs.

Music
Music made for the demo was created by Wooden Pixel, you can check out more of his music here
